# AGENTS.md

Conduit is Sentry's real-time streaming delivery layer: a Rust workspace with
three services (gateway, publish, cleanup) and two shared libraries (broker,
monitoring), deployed via GoCD pipelines generated from jsonnet.

## Quality gates

`make check` runs every quality gate (fmt, clippy, cargo-machete, cargo-deny,
typos, rumdl, hadolint, shellcheck, jactionlint, agnix). It must pass before a
change is done. CI runs the same command. `make fix` applies the safe autofixes.

## Generated files

`gocd/generated-pipelines/` is generated by `make gocd` from
`gocd/templates/`. Never edit it by hand; change the jsonnet and regenerate.

## Lint exceptions

Never disable a lint rule to get a change through. An exception is narrow (one
path, one rule), carries a reason in a comment, and needs a human decision.
Suppressions that hide a security or risk finding carry a `(review YYYY-MM-DD)`
date.
